chapter: Out-of-town work, Bourbon Street and recordings
title: Playing the way the boss wants
summary: He says he would have rejoined Kid Ory's band but his style was restricted by the bandleader.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: About stuff I was up there. Probably I would have got a chance to play with Kid Ora at the time because when we came back he hadn't made contact with Alvin and Alvin went back to play with Kid Ora and I do believe I would have had a chance to go back and play with Kid Ora if Ake would have let me play the way I wanted to play. But that's the play he's style of
playing. Oh yeah. Well now you do play a little more?
Oh yeah I'm relaxing I play the way I want nobody to worry me you know the way the band is not.
Have you changed your style through the years?
No no no I never changed. The only time my style was changed like I said when I was up there with Ted and I had to play the way he said he's the boss of the band.
And if you want to play you want to, I like that. If you want to make any money you have to do what the boss said you could do.
